$description: Old interface-kit v1.1 names (--os-*) mapped to contract names, through 0.3.x (0.2.x never reached npm) and deleted no earlier than 0.4.0, only when a count of their uses in the consumers reads 0 (xvzo6.2 C2, ARCH 2026-11-10). Where v1.1 drifted from the ratified v1.0 values (muted, focus, radius steps, label), the alias points at the contract name, so a v1.1 consumer changes value, not name (ARCH 2026-11-10). A typography target becomes a `font` shorthand.
